name: Kanojo Baishuntou
source:
While returning from a class trip, the boat sinks in a fire, stranding certain classmates and a teacher on a completely uninhabited island.
The lover of the protagonist is the only girl among them, and it's only a matter of time before carnal desires take over...

[Edited from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE080538.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
修学旅行返程途中，船只起火沉没，几名同学与一位老师流落到一座彻底无人居住的荒岛。
主人公的恋人是其中唯一的女性，众人的肉欲占据理智也只是时间问题……
